messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 27(2)

Article 27 Notifying authorities. 2. Member States may decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 shall be carried out by a national accreditation body, as defined in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 in accordance with that Regulation.

response.text:
Member States | mayDecide | assessment and monitoring under paragraph 1 is carried out by a national accreditation body | | "Member States may decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 shall be carried out by a national accreditation body"
national accreditation body | isDefinedIn | Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 | | "as defined in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008"
assessment and monitoring by national accreditation body | mustFollow | Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 | where a Member State chooses this option | "in accordance with that Regulation"
